evidence.query: Reviewed Johnnie Walker Black Label Islay Origin producer evidence
evidence.summary: Johnnie Walker's launch release describes the Origin Series as four 12-year-old blended Scotch whiskies and says Islay Origin is made exclusively with single malts from Islay, including Lagavulin and Caol Ila.

results.title: Explore the Flavours of Scotland With the Johnnie Walker Black Label Origin Series
results.description: Producer launch evidence for the 12-year-old Islay Origin release and its exclusively Islay single-malt composition.
